articles.title: Google and the UK will steer planes around contrails over the Atlantic
articles.summary: The UK government and Google are launching a trial to steer aircraft around climate-warming contrails. Google announced Operation Blue Skies on Tuesday. articles.title: Scrapping your petrol car for An EV pays back In three years
articles.summary: Research published in Science finds that scrapping a petrol car in its first year and replacing it with a battery electric vehicle cuts emissions by 58% over 16 years, with carbon payback in about three years. The benefit does not hold for efficient hybrids, very low-mileage vehicles or the dirtiest electricity grids.
